title: console pages outside app-shell (Flow runs, Integrations, Audit log, AI pending actions, App management, Profile, Settings, Docs) still draw a hand-made h1 header instead of the console page header
body:
Derived in-flight sub-issue of #12526. It carries the family the dispatch ruled out of that card: the console pages outside `@object-ui/app-shell` that still draw their own page header. It inherits `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` from #12526, by the dispatching seat (`domain:ui` seat 1, session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`). The parent design is the maintainer-approved audit finding F6 behind #12526: one page header for every console page.

Parent: #12526. That card's PR objectui#12552 exports the console page header from `@object-ui/app-shell` as `ConsolePageHeader`. This card is dispatchable only after that PR merges.

Blocked-by: #12526 (its PR objectui#12552 must merge first)

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch, in `apps/console/src/pages/**` (`@object-ui/console`), size M.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, read with #12526's own dedupe, which found #4761: two header components, one spelling): no open card adopts the console page header on these pages.

## What happens

After #12526, an object list, a dashboard and the Approvals Inbox draw one header: icon chip · title · subtitle beside it · actions. These console pages still draw a hand-made `h1` header, each in its own size and shape. Read by `git grep` at objectui `main` `b51242899b` (the #12526 dev report, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`):

- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx` (component ref `developer:flow-runs`)
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/IntegrationsPage.tsx` (`developer:integrations`)
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx` (`audit:log`)
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/AiPendingActionsPage.tsx` (`ai:approvals`)
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx`
- `apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsHub.tsx` and `SettingsView.tsx`
- `apps/console/src/pages/DocsIndex.tsx`

The error and empty-state `h1`s in `BookPage`, `DocPage`, `DocsSlug` and `SharedRecordPage` are not page headers and are out of scope.

## What to build

1. Each page above draws `ConsolePageHeader` with its existing title, subtitle and actions. Texts and i18n keys are unchanged. ⛔ No new keys.
2. Each page keeps its current phone behaviour, as #12526 measured for the inbox.
3. Re-run the `git grep` at dispatch. A page added since then joins this card. A page whose header is not a page header (an error or empty state) does not.

## Acceptance

- Per page, a test that it renders `page-header` with its title and no `h1` of its own.
- A browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on three of the pages: the same header height, title size and icon chip as the Leads list.
- One changeset for `@object-ui/console`, patch.

Attribution: filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 in session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB` (account `sunhaolin`), from the #12526 dev report.
